sequence_points.name: Landscape Series Wall Display
sequence_points.description: A horizontal sequence of framed landscape paintings mounted on a white wall, featuring natural scenes with muted earth tones and sky elements. The artworks are evenly spaced and appear to depict rural or coastal environments.

sequence_points.description: A museum wall display featuring a series of framed paintings arranged horizontally, accompanied by a white bust sculpture on a pedestal below. The paintings vary in color and subject, including landscapes and abstract forms, mounted on a neutral gray wall.

sequence_points.description: A large landscape painting depicting a river scene under a dynamic sky, featuring warm earth tones and soft brushwork. It is mounted on a white gallery wall alongside other artworks in a museum setting.
